changelog:
v4.2.11 — The app now records why it closed, so problems get fixed faster

• When the app closes by itself, it now records the reason. Until now it could only record one narrow type of crash, so a debug log often came back empty even when the app really had been closing repeatedly — which made those problems very hard to track down. It now also captures freezes, closures caused by the device running out of memory, and video decoder crashes.

• Crash records now include which app version they happened on. Older records didn't, so a problem that was already fixed months ago could look like it was still happening today.

• If support asks you to send a debug log, it will now contain far more of what's actually needed.

There are no changes to playback or the interface in this update. All v4.2.4-v4.2.10 fixes (live TV rebuffering, Home screen freezes, 4K and Dolby playback, buffering) are included.
